interventions.title: Midblock Pedestrian Refuge
interventions.description: Convert the painted median into a raised concrete refuge island to facilitate safer two-stage crossings.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with signage to clearly delineate pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Green Infrastructure
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a physical buffer between the sidewalk and traffic while visually narrowing the street to slow vehicles.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to improve pedestrian visibility and reduce crossing distance.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for both pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) at the intersection to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting / Parking Restrictions
interventions.description: Remove the parking space immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance
interventions.description: Relocate or consolidate awning supports to the furniture zone or building facade to provide a clear, unobstructed pedestrian through-zone.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint to provide a designated and safer crossing point for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway while helping to calm traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and appropriate signage to provide a designated and safer crossing point.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add street trees and a furniture zone to create a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevating the midblock crossing to sidewalk level would slow approaching vehicles and increase pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer
interventions.description: Adding a planting strip or street trees would provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Midblock Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk to provide a legal and safer crossing point.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Utilize the existing painted buffer space to install a raised refuge island.

interventions.title: Dedicated Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Redesign the sidewalk to include a dedicated furniture zone for utility poles and trash placement, ensuring a clear and accessible through-zone for walking.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a physical buffer, reduce the perceived width of the road to slow traffic, and improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Permanent Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Replace the painted buffer and flex posts on the right with permanent concrete curb extensions to shorten crossing distances and physically slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk widening and obstruction relocation
interventions.description: Moving utility poles and ensuring a clear, unobstructed walking path of at least 6 feet would drastically improve pedestrian safety and accessibility.

interventions.title: Continuous sidewalk across driveway
interventions.description: Implementing a sidewalk-level driveway crossing would maintain pedestrian priority and force vehicles to slow down when entering or exiting the parking lot.

interventions.title: Standardized high-visibility crosswalk
interventions.description: Replacing the non-standard green markings with high-visibility continental crosswalk markings would better communicate the crossing to drivers.

interventions.title: Concrete Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at intersections to reduce crossing distances and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane Upgrades
interventions.description: Replace flexible posts with permanent concrete barriers or planters to provide real protection for cyclists and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install lighting specifically oriented toward the sidewalk and crossing area to improve nighttime safety.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Strip
interventions.description: Add a landscaped buffer or furniture zone between the curb and the sidewalk to separate pedestrians from moving traffic.

interventions.title: Utility Pole Relocation
interventions.description: Move utility poles to the edge of the sidewalk or underground to ensure a consistent clear width for the pedestrian through zone.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with curb extensions and signage to provide a safe crossing point for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to provide a 3-7 second head start for pedestrians before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to ensure clear sight lines for all road users.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Add vegetation to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway while improving the streetscape.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility continental markings to provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility pedestrian crossing signs to alert drivers to the midblock crossing.
